274594530.description: This fossil collection kit includes a variety of fossil specimens organized in a segmented display box. The kit comes with an identification sheet detailing the kingdom, phylum, class or order, and genus or species of the fossils. It features specimens such as mollusks, brachiopods, trilobites, and plant fossils.

274552319.description: This listing is for a Memorex 10-pack of DVD+R LightScribe Cool Colors recordable discs. Each disc offers 4.7GB of storage capacity and supports up to 120 minutes of recording time at 16x speed. The discs are compatible with LightScribe technology, enabling direct disc labeling with custom designs. The package is sealed in plastic and unopened, maintaining excellent condition. It supports multiple languages, indicating wide compatibility. Manufactured by Imation Enterprises Corp., these discs are suitable for data storage, video recording, and media archiving.
